title: API: Create & Edit without Delete creates an untracked part and flips tracking with 201 (D14, by design)
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location "Staging Heavy Duty". API calls are replayed from Chrome DevTools (Network tab: copy the request the screen sent, edit, resend) against sv10647api.qa.shopview.com with header X-Location-ID = the current location. Logged in as (b) custom role "QA PL Create&Edit" (View + Create & Edit, Delete unticked); a second browser logged in as (a) for cleanup. Data: QAPL-T5 (tracked, with stock). D14 (by design, SV-11958 not a defect): a Create & Edit role without Delete is hidden/disabled in the UI but accepted by the API for status changes, tracking flips, untracked creates and the delete guard; only View only gets 403. Pick Category before typing Cost (known pre-existing: Cost first sends calculate-sell-price with an empty category → 400 "Invalid UUID" / "Failed to calculate sell price.").
custom_steps:
1. As (b) on /parts/inventory click New Inventory Part; type Description "QA S8 tracked b", Part Number "QA-S8-B-{run}", pick a Category, type Cost 10.00 and Save; copy the POST /api/inventory/parts/create request.
  2. Resend it with "partNumber":"QA-S8-BU-{run}", "description":"QA S8 untracked b" and "isTracked":false.
  3. Reload /parts/inventory, search QA-S8-BU-{run} and open the part.
  4. Open QAPL-T5, change nothing and click Save; copy the POST /api/inventory/parts/change request and resend it with "isTracked":false.
  5. Reload the list, search QAPL-T5 and open its Part History.
  6. Resend the change with "isTracked":true and reload the list.
  7. Cleanup as (a): open QA-S8-B-{run} and QA-S8-BU-{run} and click Delete Part on each.
custom_expected:
1. The switch is on and disabled; the tracked part saves (201) and its row shows "{n} available".
  2. 201 with "isTracked":false: accepted, by design (D14); not a defect.
  3. Total Qty reads "Not Tracked"; in the dialog the switch shows off and is disabled.
  4. 201 with data.is_tracked: false (D14, accepted although the switch is disabled in the UI).
  5. Total Qty reads "Not Tracked"; Part History shows "Tracking turned off" with Staff = the (b) user.
  6. 201 with data.is_tracked: true; the row shows "{n} available" again with its quantity unchanged.
  7. Both parts are deleted at once and leave the list.
